hero.description:
Search and share skills for coding agents in one place.
Connect via Claude Code plugin or the CLI.

step1.title: Ask in Natural Language
step1.description: "Review my code", "Let's do TDD" — just talk to your agent as usual.

step2.title: Auto Skill Discovery
step2.description: Your agent reads the context and automatically finds the right skill from AI Toolkit.

step3.title: Instant Execution
step3.description: The skill loads and runs a proven workflow. No install or setup — it just works.

lazyLoading.title: Instant Use, Zero Install
lazyLoading.description: No need to download skills in advance. With MCP server connected, skills are loaded on demand and always up to date.

autoRecommend.title: Auto Recommendations
autoRecommend.description: Your coding agent reads the context and automatically finds and applies relevant skills. Just describe what you need in natural language.

multiAgent.title: Any Coding Agent
multiAgent.description: Claude Code plugin, CLI, or MCP direct — share the same skills however you connect. Works with any coding agent that supports MCP.

connect.title: Plugin

1.title: Run the command
1.description: Paste the command above into your terminal to register the plugin.

2.title: Google Sign-in
2.description: When the browser opens, sign in with your Google account.

3.title: Start using
3.description: Once connected, your coding agent automatically searches and applies relevant skills. No manual lookup needed.
